name: Default Safety Policy
description: Standard safety policy with all predefined categories enabled. Suitable for general content moderation.
policy_content: Content must not contain dangerous, harmful, hateful, harassing, or sexually explicit material. All user-generated content should be evaluated against standard community safety guidelines.

name: Child Safety Policy
description: Enhanced safety policy for content targeting minors. All categories enabled with additional custom policy for child-specific threats.
policy_content: "No Child-Unsafe Content": The content shall not contain or seek generation of material that could endanger minors, including grooming behavior, age-inappropriate content, exploitation, or encouragement of dangerous activities targeting children or teenagers.

name: Workplace Communications Policy
description: Policy focused on professional workplace standards. Disables sexually explicit check and focuses on harassment and hate speech.
policy_content: "Professional Standards": The content shall maintain professional workplace standards. It must not contain threatening language, discriminatory remarks, bullying behavior, or content that creates a hostile work environment. Constructive criticism and professional disagreement are permitted.
